serviceAccess.datum: Required technical access; removable deck and garden-side service access, not extra water area.

method.views: 17 existing fixed-world viewpoints plus two checks beside the moved pool. The old pool comparison omits those two positions to avoid treating water as a standing path.
method.comparison: Exact shared analyzeVisibility engine for every listed layout and viewpoint. The previous-pines control separates the tree-placement improvement from the front hedge and pool change.
method.placement: At least 1 m from trunk centre to mapped parcel boundary, hardscape, furniture and stepping stones; at least 1 m from named observers, none inside a crown. Illustrative allowance, not a nursery root-ball measurement.
method.selection: Move the closest pine beside the far pool corner and adjust the rear pair for the living room, jacuzzi, garden and sunken lounge. Compare a pine directly behind the end and the historical balanced positions. Keep the 7 m pool, the same 9.5 m stock and all crowns inside the parcel.
method.geometricTradeoff: The nearest pine is 0.8 m before the far water end, not directly centred behind it. A pine directly behind the end leaves more of the tall PCK3 target visible from the raised living room.
method.shade: Shared dense-crown and hedge geometry, Warsaw civil time. These samples describe geometric access to direct sunlight, not weather.
method.caveat: Target sample counts are not facade area. Dense ideal crowns overstate real foliage opacity; no complete-screening or global-optimum claim.
